content:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a p99/p95 regression in the canary after the traffic bump at 12:18 UTC. p95 went from ~220ms -> 450ms, p99 from ~980ms -> ~2.8s. Streaming stalls (clients report partial chunking and long gaps). Model: rdx-text-v13-ml, region us-west-2, canary weight moved to 25% at 12:18 UTC. Any objections to immediate traffic rollback to 0%?

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: paging oncall (pd:PD-INC-823) — alert: canary.p99>2s (x3), streaming_stall_rate 4% (>alert 1%). Links: https://console.redwood/alerts/PD-INC-823

maria: I'm on it. Taking lead. @jin single-thread triage for infra, @sam check model-side perf and kernel stats.

sam: quick check — new attention kernel in v13 switched to fused-kv-path, suspicious with our small-seq streaming pattern. Could be KV cache thrash or boarding/unboarding overhead. Looking at kv_cache_evictions/sec now.

eng-sre-bot: metrics snapshot: canary=rds-v13: requests/min 7.2k -> 8.9k, avg_tok_latency +30%, kv_cache_evictions/sec spike x18 at 12:20 UTC, batch_size distribution unchanged.

jin: oncall here. Confirming elevated connection stalls on host pool gw-usw2-3 and scorer nodes. Running tail logs:
```
[12:19:42] scorer-17 WARN: kv_cache miss spike 0.14 -> 0.98
[12:20:05] gw-usw2-3 INFO: stream_chunk_delay 1200ms
[12:20:30] scorer-12 ERROR: write timeout to gpu-queue 2000ms
```

alex: Okay — Maria, if we can cut canary weight back to 5% now and monitor for 2 minutes. If p99 still >1.5s or stalls persist, roll back to v12 fully.

maria: Doing weight adjust now. Command: ```rdctl rollout adjust --model rdx-text-v13-ml --env prod --weight 5 --reason "p99 spike 12:18 canary"```

deploy-bot: rollout adjust accepted — canary weight -> 5% (request id fb12c). Applying change across us-west-2 pools.

sam: Observing kv_cache_evictions/sec drop but still high on a subset of scorer nodes. Looks like eviction thrash persists on nodes that warmed with v12 then got v13 traffic. Hypothesis: v13 increases KV entries per request -> more frequent eviction.

cs-ops: any customer impact numbers? I see a small uptick in 5xxs on the API gateway for keys in us-west-2 around 12:20 — approx 0.18% -> 0.45% for a 10m window. Should we prepare a brief CS note?

jin: p95 now 300ms, p99 1.6s after weight ->5%. streaming_stall_rate down from 4% -> 1.2%. Still above SLO threshold.

alex: Good reduction but still above SLO. Maria — can we try full rollback (v13 -> v12)? We'll coordinate a fast rollback and notify CS.

maria: I can roll back. Command to escalate: ```rdctl rollout set-weight --model rdx-text-v13-ml --env prod --weight 0 && rdctl rollout promote --model rdx-text-v12-ml --env prod --weight 100 --force```

sam: +1. Also recommend disabling the fused-kv kernel on canary nodes if we want a narrower mitigation to validate kernel as root cause. There's a kernel flag: ATTENTION_KERNEL=fallback.

maria: Rolling back now. Executing set-weight 0 (fb12c) then promote v12.

deploy-bot: rollout set-weight accepted — canary weight -> 0 (req id fb12c-rollback). promote v12 queued (req id fb12c-promote). Estimated propagation 60-90s.

eng-sre-bot: post-change metrics will be captured to incidents/3977774242/metrics-snapshot-1, snapshots at +30s and +120s.

jin: immediate observations 30s post rollback: p95 245ms, p99 770ms, streaming_stall_rate 0.4%. Errors back to baseline ~0.12%.

cs-ops: Notifying affected customers with a brief blurb: "We observed elevated latency and streaming stalls in us-west-2 following a canary model rollout. Traffic has been rolled back to the previous model; metrics returning to normal. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Draft ready, sending to legal for sign-off.

alex: Great. Next steps: 1) keep rollback in place and monitor for 30m; 2) run reproducible load tests of v13 with seq patterns that cause KV pressure; 3) postmortem and kernel/kv action items. Assign owners: sam -> reproduce and perf repro, jin -> infra node analysis and warmup behavior, maria -> stabilise rollout automation (safety gates), cs-ops -> customer comms.

sam: I'll spin up a canary of v13 on a small isolated pool and run scripted streaming with prefix-heavy workload. Will test ATTENTION_KERNEL=fallback vs fused.

maria: Noted. I'll add an automated rollout gate: block >10% step without kv_evictions/sec below threshold and p99 <1s for 5m.

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll open the incident and assign sev2. Postmortem owner to be decided after initial RCA. :white_check_mark:

cs-ops: Keeping thread open for updates. If anything customer-impacting changes, ping PD and escalate.

-- end of thread --
